page.title: Publishing
page.subtitle: A publishing credential is single-use: redeeming it mints a long-lived publishing identity (key_id).

apply.title: Request publishing credential
apply.productExtra: The solution name you are publishing (lowercase, a-z0-9- only). Identity = product + your username; it cannot be changed later.

issued.title: Credential created (shown once)
